name: Redstone Repeater
snippet: A redstone repeater is a block that produces a full-strength redstone signal from its front while its back is powered , with four toggleable delay settings. Read more

name: Block of Redstone - Minecraft Wiki - Fandom
snippet: A block of redstone is a mineral block equivalent to nine redstone dust. It acts as a permanently powered redstone power source that can be pushed by pistons. Read more
